controls.title: Demonstrate commitment to integrity and ethical values
controls.summary: The organization demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values through its security policies, code of conduct, and management oversight.
implementationChecklist: Establish and communicate a code of conduct
Define security policies and ensure management review
Implement whistleblower and ethics reporting mechanisms

controls.title: Communicate security objectives internally
controls.summary: The organization communicates its security objectives, policies, and standards to internal personnel to support the functioning of internal controls.
implementationChecklist: Distribute security policies to all employees

controls.title: Identify and assess risks to security objectives
controls.summary: The organization specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable the identification and assessment of risks relating to its security commitments.
implementationChecklist: Maintain a risk register with identified threats and vulnerabilities
Assess likelihood and impact of identified risks

controls.title: Assess fraud risk
controls.summary: The organization considers the potential for fraud when assessing risks, including unauthorized access, manipulation of data, and misuse of assets.
implementationChecklist: Include fraud scenarios in risk assessments
Implement separation of duties for critical functions
Monitor for indicators of fraudulent activity

controls.title: Select and develop control activities
controls.summary: The organization selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of security objectives.
implementationChecklist: Implement detective, preventive, and corrective controls
evidenceExamples: Control matrix mapping controls to risks

controls.title: Implement logical access security
controls.summary: The organization implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures to protect information assets against unauthorized access.
implementationChecklist: Enforce multi-factor authentication for privileged access
Encrypt data at rest and in transit
evidenceExamples: Access control policy and RBAC configuration

controls.title: Manage credentials and authentication
controls.summary: The organization manages credentials for infrastructure and software, implementing password policies, key management, and credential rotation.
implementationChecklist: Use secrets management tools (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager)

controls.title: Authorize and manage access based on least privilege
controls.summary: The organization authorizes, modifies, and removes access to data and resources based on the principle of least privilege and role-based requirements.

controls.title: Restrict access to system boundaries
controls.summary: The organization restricts access at system boundaries, including network perimeters, DMZs, and API gateways, to authorized connections only.
implementationChecklist: Implement API gateway authentication and rate limiting

controls.title: Prevent and detect unauthorized software
controls.summary: The organization implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software.
implementationChecklist: Deploy endpoint protection and anti-malware solutions

controls.title: Detect and monitor security events
controls.summary: The organization uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify anomalies and security events that could indicate security incidents.

controls.title: Monitor system components for anomalies
controls.summary: The organization monitors system components and the operation of those components for anomalies that are indicative of malicious acts or system failures.
implementationChecklist: Implement infrastructure monitoring (CPU, memory, disk, network)
Set baseline metrics and anomaly detection thresholds
Review monitoring alerts and escalate appropriately

controls.title: Evaluate and respond to security events
controls.summary: The organization evaluates detected security events and determines whether they constitute security incidents requiring response.
implementationChecklist: Define incident classification and severity levels
Establish incident response procedures and playbooks
Document and review incident response actions

controls.title: Manage changes to infrastructure and software
controls.summary: The organization authorizes, designs, develops, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure and software.
implementationChecklist: Implement change management process with approvals
Require code reviews for all production changes
Maintain separate development, staging, and production environments

controls.title: Identify and manage vendor risk
controls.summary: The organization identifies, selects, and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners who have access to the organization's systems or data.
implementationChecklist: Maintain a vendor inventory with risk classifications
Include security requirements in vendor contracts

controls.title: Maintain system availability commitments
controls.summary: The organization maintains, monitors, and evaluates current processing capacity and use of system components to manage capacity demand and enable the implementation of additional capacity.

controls.title: Implement disaster recovery and business continuity
controls.summary: The organization implements backup, recovery, and business continuity procedures to ensure system availability in the event of disruptions.

controls.title: Ensure processing completeness and accuracy
controls.summary: The organization implements policies and procedures over system processing to ensure completeness, validity, accuracy, and timeliness of outputs.
implementationChecklist: Implement input validation and data integrity checks
Use checksums or hashes for data integrity verification
